name: Viscera Sucker
descr: A vampiric demon whose upper body detaches at sundown to fly through nearby villages in search of victims. It has a winged upper body with hanging entrails.

data.motivesAndTactics: Clamp onto prey, suck blood, tear in half

features.name: Join or Die
features.text: The Viscera Sucker dies if it hasn't reconnected its upper and lower halves by dawn.

features.name: Entangling Entrails
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Viscera Sucker latch onto a target within Very Close range, _Restraining_ them until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (16).

features.name: Lifesuck
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Viscera Sucker drink blood from a _Restrained_ target within Melee range. The target marks a HP, and the Viscera Sucker clears a HP.
